tickets.title: Collect Pocket Lantern Analytics equity award documents
tickets.text: Collect the formal grant agreement, vesting schedule exhibit, and tax withholding election instructions for Adrian Copperwisp's Pocket Lantern Analytics restricted stock units (initial stated grant value $360,000, three-year vest). Adrian has the offer letter and summary but not the formal grant documents.
tickets.evidence: This unresolved document collection issue for the Pocket Lantern Analytics equity award needs follow-up by 2025-08-15.

tickets.title: Compare Pocket Lantern Analytics benefits to Moonbadger coverage
tickets.text: Prepare a written comparison of Pocket Lantern Analytics medical, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, and disability elections against Lena Copperwisp's Moonbadger Health Group family medical coverage for Adrian Copperwisp. The comparison should support his benefits portal selections before submission.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to provide that comparison by 2025-07-25.

tickets.title: Recommend coverage for job-change benefits gap
tickets.text: Provide a coverage recommendation for Adrian and Lena Copperwisp that accounts for the gap between Adrian's former Buttonwood Balloon Robotics coverage and his first effective date under Pocket Lantern Analytics materials. The recommendation should address Milo Copperwisp's continuing orthodontia and Lena's existing Moonbadger Health Group family plan option.

tickets.title: Prepare final benefit election notes for Lena's review
tickets.text: Prepare final benefit election notes for Adrian Copperwisp in plain language so Lena Copperwisp can review them after her hospital shifts before Adrian submits selections through the Paper Otter Benefits enrollment screen. The notes should account for the limited new-hire election window.

tickets.title: Obtain Pocket Lantern Analytics long-term disability certificate
tickets.text: Obtain the long-term disability certificate from Pocket Lantern Analytics for Adrian Copperwisp, including the elimination period, taxable-benefit treatment, own-occupation language, and maximum monthly benefit. The benefits packet Adrian uploaded included a premium schedule but not the certificate.
tickets.evidence: The missing Pocket Lantern Analytics long-term disability certificate remains an unresolved issue needing follow-up by 2025-07-22.

tickets.title: Confirm HSA eligibility under household coverage
tickets.text: Confirm for Adrian Copperwisp whether household coverage under Lena Copperwisp's Moonbadger Health Group plan would affect his eligibility for the Pocket Lantern Analytics HSA-eligible medical option before he chooses payroll HSA contributions.
tickets.evidence: this health savings account payroll setup issue needs follow-up by 2025-07-25.

tickets.title: Estimate reimbursable medical expenses for FSA election
tickets.text: Estimate the household's remaining reimbursable medical expenses for Adrian Copperwisp's Pocket Lantern Analytics FSA election, accounting for Milo Copperwisp's continuing orthodontia and the midyear employer change. Use the estimate to recommend an FSA election amount.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up on the flexible spending account election amount is due 2025-07-28.

tickets.title: Resolve Pocket Lantern Analytics payroll portal access
tickets.text: Resolve the identity-verification error Adrian Copperwisp is seeing on the Pocket Lantern Analytics payroll portal so he can view direct deposit, tax withholding, and contribution setup screens. Paper Otter Benefits accepted his login but the payroll portal blocked access.
tickets.evidence: This payroll portal access problem remains an unresolved issue needing follow-up by 2025-07-21.

tickets.title: Verify Buttonwood Balloon Robotics 401(k) after-tax source
tickets.text: Verify the after-tax employee contribution source in Adrian Copperwisp's former Buttonwood Balloon Robotics 401(k) (balance approximately $612,000, with about $27,500 in the after-tax subaccount). Confirm whether the after-tax subaccount has previously been converted to Roth, since the year-end statement does not separately show basis, earnings, or prior in-plan Roth conversion activity.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to verify the Buttonwood Balloon Robotics 401(k) after-tax source by 2025-07-31.

tickets.title: Arrange support for old 401(k) distribution-options call
tickets.text: Arrange a service call between Adrian Copperwisp and the Buttonwood Balloon Robotics 401(k) recordkeeper because the online distribution page did not display a combined pre-tax, Roth, and after-tax rollover path.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to arrange support for the old 401(k) distribution-options call by 2025-08-05.

tickets.title: Review Pocket Lantern Analytics 401(k) contribution election
tickets.text: Review Adrian Copperwisp's Pocket Lantern Analytics 401(k) contribution election given his higher salary ($285,000 base) and $40,000 signing bonus, which could make the default contribution rate inconsistent with the household's retirement savings target for the remainder of the year. The plan offers traditional pre-tax and Roth salary deferral options, with employer matching after eligibility.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up on Adrian’s Pocket Lantern Analytics 401(k) contribution election is due 2025-08-08.

tickets.title: Analyze Roth versus pre-tax contribution mix
tickets.text: Analyze for Adrian Copperwisp whether his new Pocket Lantern Analytics 401(k) deferrals should be pre-tax, Roth, or split, given the $40,000 signing bonus, expected equity income, Lena Copperwisp's wages (about $138,000 per year as a Moonbadger Health Group nurse practitioner), and the household's current tax bracket.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up on the Roth versus pre-tax contribution mix for the new employer plan is due 2025-08-12.

tickets.title: Review former employer stock concentration in old 401(k)
tickets.text: Review the approximately $52,000 of Buttonwood Balloon Robotics company stock units held inside Adrian Copperwisp's former employer 401(k) (balance approximately $612,000) as a separate concentration issue from the household's taxable technology fund position.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up on the former employer stock concentration review inside the old plan is due 2025-08-18.

tickets.title: Update employer life insurance beneficiary designations
tickets.text: Update Adrian Copperwisp's employer life insurance beneficiary designations through the new Pocket Lantern Analytics benefits portal. His former Buttonwood Balloon Robotics group life coverage ended with employment separation, and the 2016 estate documents drafted by Thimble Harbor Law still name Simon Copperwisp in a key family role.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up on employer life insurance beneficiary designations is due 2025-07-30.

tickets.title: Review signing bonus supplemental withholding
tickets.text: Review Adrian Copperwisp's paycheck and estimated-tax position, focusing on whether the supplemental withholding on the $40,000 signing bonus is too low when combined with Lena Copperwisp's wages, expected equity income, and prior quarterly estimated payments, to avoid preventable tax underpayment penalties during the job transition year.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up on the signing bonus withholding estimate is due 2025-08-20.

tickets.title: Coordinate transition-year tax projections with CPA
tickets.text: Coordinate with Priya Maplesprocket of Mossy Meteor CPAs on Adrian and Lena Copperwisp's transition-year tax projections, accounting for two W-2s for Adrian, Lena's wages, the $40,000 signing bonus, possible restricted stock income, and prior quarterly estimated payments, before year-end planning decisions are made.
tickets.evidence: The agreed CPA coordination for transition-year tax projections is due 2025-09-05.
